reference: D.-K. Xing, J.-Y. He, P. Wang, H.-Y. Guo, K. Chang, C.-C. Liu, Y.-G. Liu, Z. Wang, 'Intermodal dispersive waves and soliton collision during multimode supercontinuum generation in chalcogenide glass fiber', Laser Phys. 32, 115401 (2022)
access_note: Not open access (Unpaywall is_oa = False). No PDF archived (paywall/copyright). The full text was read via the IOP landing page (full HTML; curl/scrapers hit a Radware captcha). Every number below is quoted directly from that text unless flagged.
description: A step-index As2Se3/As2S3 multimode chalcogenide fibre pumped at the HE11 zero-dispersion wavelength, reported to generate an intermodal dispersive wave at 10.8 um (TE01 <-> HE21b) via the phase-matching condition of its Eq. (7). This deck re-solves the paper's own inputs (Sellmeier Eqs. 5/6, the 10 um-core step-index modes, Eq. 7) from first principles and checks the outputs. Verdict: the material model is reproducible (after restoring a dropped square in Eq. 6), but neither the HE11 ZDW (6.104 um) nor the 10.8 um intermodal DW is reproducible from the stated inputs.

fiber.index_model: Sellmeier, paper Eqs. (5) and (6): Eq. (5) = As2S3 (5 terms), Eq. (6) = As2Se3 (3 terms)
fiber.index_sources: cited in the paper to its refs [30], [31]; the reference list did not render in the session, so the primary fits are UNVERIFIED. Eq. (6) is recognisably the Thompson-2008 As2Se3 fit.

modes.zdw_other_modes: TE01, TM01, HE21 stay in normal dispersion across the whole band (paper)

raman.source: paper Table 1, cited to its ref [32]
raman.caveat: f_R = 0.148, tau1 = 23 fs, tau2 = 164.5 fs are classic As2S3 (Agrawal) Raman parameters, yet the CORE is As2Se3. A reproduction should treat this as 'as published' and flag the possible material mismatch.

includes: full non-degenerate multimode FWM sum over l,m,n

headline_result.condition: paper Eq. (7): beta_cr(w) = beta_s(w_s) + beta1_s (w - w_s) + gamma P / 2

reproduction_status.material_as2s3_eq5: reproduced; matches the repository's validated As2S3 row
reproduction_status.material_as2se3_eq6: eq (6) as printed is broken (B = 19, pole at sqrt(19) = 4.359 um, wrong material ZDW); restored to B = 19^2 = 361 it matches the repository's validated As2Se3 row (n(4) = 2.783, material ZDW 7.22 um)
reproduction_status.he11_zdw: NOT reproduced: the exact vector solver puts the HE11 ZDW ~1.3 um short of the paper's 6.104 um (vector HE11 ZDW = 4.849 um; scalar LP01 = 4.962 um)
reproduction_status.higher_order_modes: NOT reproduced: the paper states TE01/TM01/HE21 stay normal across the band, but the exact vector solver puts all three anomalous at the pump, with ZDWs at 3.79-3.90 um (the scalar-LP LP11 ZDW is 3.901 um, so this is a property of the guide, not a solver artefact)
reproduction_status.intermodal_dw: NOT reproduced: no pair has an Eq. (7) root in the 8-13 um red window, so the paper's 10.8 um DW is not supported by the stated inputs; the paper's own pair (TE01<->HE21) instead phase-matches a BLUE DW at ~1.94 um (HE11-soliton partners ~2.24 um). The repository's phase_matching.dispersive_wave_roots is intramodal-only and cannot express this intermodal condition (fed the partner it returns the soliton wavelength as a spurious root); the scan is instead re-checked with a 2-point vs 5-point beta1 scheme
